meta.title: Hotel Corali Paros | Seaside hotel in Piso Livadi
meta.description: Hotel Corali in Piso Livadi, Paros: rooms and apartments with balconies above the little harbour, 200 m from the beach and 300 m from Logaras. Book direct for the best rate.

hero.lead: A family-run hotel above the little harbour of Piso Livadi. Wake up to fishing boats, walk down to the sea.
hero.photoAlt: View from a Hotel Corali balcony over Piso Livadi harbour towards Naxos

booking.title: Book direct
booking.perk: Best rate when you book directly with us

intro.title: White, blue and the sound of the harbour.
intro.body: On the quieter east coast of Paros, Corali looks over the little harbour of Piso Livadi with Naxos across the water. Cycladic arches, light everywhere and hosts who know every corner of the island.

rooms.title: Rooms full of light and sea
rooms.lead: Simple, spotless, Cycladic. Choose a room for two or an apartment for family and friends.

items.name: Double rooms
items.text: A stone feature wall, warm light and a balcony door that opens to the morning sun.
items.alt: Hotel Corali double room with stone wall and balcony door

items.name: Apartments
items.text: A living room with a Cycladic fireplace, dining area and balcony — space for the whole family.
items.alt: Whitewashed apartment living room with Cycladic fireplace and dining table

items.name: The view
items.text: Morning coffee or chilled wine at dusk, with the harbour and Naxos in front of you.
items.alt: Table with fruit and wine on a balcony overlooking the harbour

beaches.title: Where to swim today?
beaches.lead: On Paros the wind decides. See the wind right now in Piso Livadi and which beaches are sheltered — or pick a direction yourself.
beaches.error: Weather could not be loaded — pick a wind direction.
beaches.source: Weather: Open-Meteo. Driving distances from the hotel.
beaches.calm: Flat calm — every beach is lovely today!

village.title: Piso Livadi, the authentic side of Paros
village.body: A fishing village with a marina, tavernas on the water's edge and cafés that open early. Away from the bustle, close to everything.

items.title: Logaras
items.text: A sandy beach with shallow water, perfect for children — 300 metres.

items.title: Lefkes & Marpissa
items.text: Traditional hill villages for an afternoon stroll.

items.title: Naoussa
items.text: The island's cosmopolitan harbour, about 14 km away.

items.title: Parikia
items.text: The main port and the Ekatontapyliani church, about 16 km away.

cta.text: Book directly with Corali for the best available rate and a direct line to us.
